title: Test database starts too slowly after CI change
root_cause: CI workflow reduced Postgres service healthcheck retries; tests connect before the DB accepts connections.
explanation: Yesterday's change to .github/workflows/ci.yml cut the Postgres healthcheck retries from 10 to 2. The app tests race the database and fail with connection timeouts. Application code is not at fault.
signature: could not connect to server: Connection refused
key_lines: ERROR tests/test_payments.py::test_capture - psycopg2.OperationalError: could not connect to server: Connection refused
services.postgres: healthcheck retries reduced from 10 to 2 in ci.yml@a91c2e
Hypothesis: flaky network — rejected; signature reproduces 5/5 in sandbox

proposed_fix.summary: Restore Postgres healthcheck retries to 10 and add an explicit wait-for-db step before pytest.
